description: The CID project publishes a catenary-insulator defect dataset alongside an unsupervised baseline for inspection. Its repository describes normal images, defect categories, a training split with only good examples and test folders that separate good and defective examples. The dataset is linked as a public Google Drive folder, which displayed an insulator folder at inspection. The project repository is under MIT, but the README does not expressly separate dataset-image rights from code rights; users should verify the image grant before redistribution. No charge is stated. Coverage is rail catenary components; geographic capture location, period, image count and acquisition resolution are not given in the inspected metadata. This limits representativeness claims. Simulation use includes testing visual detection of overhead-line asset condition for railway maintenance scenarios. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with image-based condition observations. The Drive files, figures and model checkpoints were not downloaded or read.
licence: MIT project repository; separate image rights not explicitly stated.
name: CID catenary insulator defect images
